bun run scripts/gen-features.ts && echo "=== count ===" && ls .aidd/features/ | wc -l && echo "=== validate JSON objects ===" && for f in .aidd/features/*/feature.json; do bun -e "const t=require('fs').readFileSync('$f','utf8'); const o=JSON.parse(t); if(Array.isArray(o)||typeof o!=='object'){console.log('INVALID:$f')}" ; done && echo "=== any passes true? ===" && grep -l '"passes": true' .aidd/features/*/feature.json || echo "none-true-good"

rm scripts/gen-features.ts && mkdir -p backend/src/{db/schema,routes,services,lib} frontend/src/{pages,components,api,stores,lib} config data && echo "dirs made" && ls -d backend frontend config data scripts
bun run scripts/setup.ts --slug habit-tracker --name "Habit Tracker" --description "A local-first habit tracker" --frontend-port 3330 --backend-port 3331 2>&1 | tail -30
bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | head -30 && echo "=== tsc exit: $? ==="
bun run smoke:qc 2>&1 | tail -30 && echo "=== smoke:qc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="

for d in backend/src/db/schema backend/src/routes backend/src/services backend/src/lib frontend/src/pages frontend/src/components frontend/src/api frontend/src/stores frontend/src/lib data; do touch "$d/.gitkeep"; done && echo "gitkeep created" && find backend frontend data -name .gitkeep
bun run scripts/setup.ts --slug habit-tracker 2>&1 | tail -12 && echo "=== FORMAT ===" && bunx prettier --write . 2>&1 | grep -v unchanged | tail -20

bun run smoke:qc 2>&1 | tail -8 && echo "=== smoke exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ===" && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && echo "tsc-ok" && echo "=== feature verify ===" && ls .aidd/features/ | wc -l && grep -l '"passes": true' .aidd/features/*/feature.json || echo "none-passing-good"

echo "=== launchable ===" && cat package.json | bun -e "const p=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); console.log('dev:',p.scripts.dev); console.log('has start+stop:', !!(p.scripts.start&&p.scripts.stop)); console.log('placeholder?', /exit 1/.test(p.scripts.dev))" && echo "=== all feature.json objects ===" && bad=0; for f in .aidd/features/*/feature.json; do bun -e "const o=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$f','utf8')); if(Array.isArray(o)) throw 0" || { echo "ARRAY:$f"; bad=1; }; done; echo "bad=$bad" && echo "=== git add ===" && git add -A && git status --short | head -50

git status --short | tail -20 && echo "=== ensure gitignored not staged ===" && git status --short | grep -E "habit-tracker.json|\.dev-servers|\.db|AGENTS.md|_common" || echo "clean-no-ignored-staged"

git commit -q -m "chore: initialize habit-tracker project

Scaffold the fresh Spernakit-like habit tracker: 25 tracked feature files,
project directory structure (backend/frontend/config/data/scripts), setup and
agent-safe start/stop scripts, JSON-only config with example template, root
tsconfig, README, and a launchable package.json contract. smoke:qc passes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <<REDACTED_EMAIL>>" && echo "=== committed ===" && git log --oneline -1 && echo "=== working tree ===" && git status --short | grep -v '^??' || echo "no-tracked-changes"
